title: Continuation doctrine
summary: Future work should deepen protocol compliance without collapsing the independent-object architecture. Put each change in the smallest authoritative layer and preserve transport, media, speech and observation boundaries.
invariants: Do not collapse call control, inbound media, outbound media, RTP RX/TX, STT/TTS or observation into one lifecycle object.
Do not move RTP back inside SIP.
Do not let SIP or RTP create private carrier sockets outside SocketProvider.
Do not turn Instrumentation Mesh or Alchemy Log into protocol authority.
Do not make Speech mandatory for SIP.
Do not infer causation from correlation.
Do not claim compliance beyond executed evidence.
Do not copy LDAP password verification into SIP; consume Identity Directory/Secret Broker through the optional credential-provider seam.
procedure: Choose the next protocol gap: transaction/dialog correctness, retransmission, CANCEL/re-INVITE/UPDATE, RTCP depth, NAT traversal, IPv6 or live COTS interoperability.
Assign it to the smallest authority layer.
Add logging/instrumentation for new transitions and an isolation test for unrelated objects.
Run strict standards and environment qualification, then update this sphere with exact evidence and limitations.

provenance.claim: Executable source remains separate from this continuity sphere.
